topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: They said the place will close. The news hits like a sudden storm, leaving no room to breathe. Tables once filled with laughter and the comforting warmth of familiar dishes stand empty, as if the very life has been drained away. Every memory, each bite shared, each smile exchanged, they all swirl now in a relentless storm of what was and what can never be again. The walls, once a backdrop to countless moments, now feel like barriers closing in. I move through the day, but it’s a ghost dance, shadows cast by a light that’s flickering out, fading into silence.
